stem: Which of the following most directly develops a theme of the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: Helen's enjoyment of the pleasant weather while making the decision to buy the van

options.label: B
options.text: Mr. Mifflin's suggestion that he could travel along with Helen for the first day of her journey

options.label: C
options.text: Mr. Mifflin's insistence to Helen that the van is worth at least four hundred dollars

options.label: D
options.text: Helen's realization that she can seek out interesting experiences just as her brother has
